params.prompt: Photorealistic real-estate shot of the exact supplied kitchen. Perform one smooth restrained eight-degree clockwise micro-arc around the fixed oak island, with constant camera height and realistic parallax, then finish on a short stable hold. Lock every white cabinet, oak island panel, quartz countertop, three olive stools, two black pendants, sink, refrigerator, range, microwave, window, floorboard and decor item in place. Keep the exact same room from first frame to last. Animate the camera only. Natural late-afternoon exposure and stable verticals. No geometry drift, moving stools, cabinet changes, object duplication, invented rooms, people, text, logos or redesign.
